bio.text: Lupe Contreras is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 22.
According to the biography on the legislature's member page, Contreras was born in Phoenix in 1975, was raised in Cashion, Arizona, and attended Westview High School.
The page says Contreras attended Estrella Mountain Community College and Glendale Community College to study criminal justice, and has coached wrestling for more than ten years.
